subject: Renewal kickoff: Fidelis Health - capacity uplift & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Morales <ellie@fidelishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: Fidelis Health - capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Ellie —

Congrats on closing out Year 1 with Fidelis. As we discussed on the call last week, we'd like to kick off the renewal and expansion conversation now so we can lock in capacity and get QBR timing on the calendar. High-level goals for this thread:

- Confirm target term and effective date (we're proposing a 12→18 month staircase to preserve current pricing tiers)
- Scope the capacity uplift (tokens/day and burst headroom) and any reserved Dedicated capacity windows
- Align stakeholders for an exec-level QBR and timeline for legal/procurement handoff

Proposed next steps / timeline:
1) This week — Fidelity of numbers: you confirm current 90-day token run-rate + target uplift (we estimated ~2.5x).
2) By EOW (Fri) — Redwood sends a first-pass SOW + pricing ladder (attached: renewal_outline_v1.pdf).
3) Next week — 30–45 minute QBR to review SLA, rollout plan, and onboarding tasks (I listed some slots below).
4) Procurement cycle — sign by June 14 to secure the dedicated pool we discussed.

Suggested QBR slots (all PT):
- Tue 21 May, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 22 May, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 23 May, 11:00–11:45

Please confirm who from Fidelis should be on the invite (we typically include: Engineering lead, Platform/Procurement, Product). I will loop in Solutions to ensure the capacity plan and runbook are ready.

Attachments: renewal_outline_v1.pdf (summary + pricing ladder). I'll follow with a SOW draft once legal has reviewed.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

---

From: Ellie Morales <ellie@fidelishealth.com>

Cc: procurement@fidelishealth.com
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Fidelis Health - capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear timeline. Quick responses below and two asks from Procurement: 

1) Stakeholders: please include our Platform lead (Aisha Guerrero) and Head of Ops (Tom Reyes). Procurement (procurement@fidelishealth.com) is looped for contract cadence.

2) Capacity numbers: the 90-day run-rate you referenced is correct (avg 5.2M tokens/day), but traffic spikes during claims processing push peak to ~14M tokens/day for short windows. The 2.5x estimate is roughly aligned, but we need guaranteed burst headroom & a failover plan.

On QBR timing — Wed 22 May at 14:00 PT works best for our execs. Can you send calendar invite? Also, please attach the SOW draft for procurement to start review.

Ellie Morales
Director, Data & AI | Fidelis Health
ellie@fidelishealth.com | (202) 555-0112

Thanks Ellie — great, Wed 22 May 14:00 PT is locked. Calendar invite sent (shared link in HubSpot).

A few clarifications based on your note:
- Peak spikes (~14M tokens/day): we recommend reserving a Dedicated burst pool sized to cover ~18M tokens/day headroom for short windows and a fallback routing policy to the hosted tier if the dedicated pool saturates.
- Term proposal: 18 months with a mid-term review at month 9 (standard staircase) — this keeps unit pricing near current levels while protecting capacity.
- Commercials & procurement: attaching SOW draft (SOW_draft_Fidelis.docx) and a short pricing ladder. Procurement, please feel free to redline the SOW; we can accept DocuSign for signatures.

Action items:
- Marcus: prepare a one-pager runbook + failover diagram (I'll attach before the QBR).
- Ben (Solutions): prepare a capacity run simulation and cost delta for dedicated vs burst-on-demand.
- Fidelis: confirm Aisha Guerrero and Tom Reyes for the QBR invite.

Docs attached: SOW_draft_Fidelis.docx; qbr-agenda-template.md. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7843

Look forward to the meeting.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
